events.description: A charged particle is initialized at the origin and begins oscillating sinusoidally along the Y-axis, with a pink acceleration vector attached to it.
events.clip_query: A red charged particle oscillating up and down with a pink acceleration vector attached to it

events.description: A 1D array of electric field vectors along the X-axis begins to react, showing a transverse wave propagating outwards as the particle oscillates.

events.description: The system reaches a steady state where a clear sinusoidal electromagnetic wave pattern is visible in the field vectors.
